seoTitle: How to Create a Stripe Checkout Page
metaDescription: Set up a Stripe Checkout page by adding products and pricing, generating a checkout link, and embedding it on your website.
intro: A hosted checkout page makes it easy to accept payments without building custom payment forms yourself. This guide covers how to set up Stripe Checkout, add products and pricing, and embed or link the checkout page on your website or online store.

steps.heading: Enable Stripe Checkout in your dashboard
steps.body: Log into your Stripe dashboard and locate the Checkout section to begin setting up a new checkout flow.

steps.heading: Add products and pricing
steps.body: Create the product listings and set their prices so Checkout knows what customers are paying for.

steps.heading: Create a checkout session or link
steps.body: Generate a checkout link or session tied to your product so customers can complete payment through Stripe's hosted page.

steps.heading: Embed the checkout page on your site
steps.body: Add the checkout link or embed code to your website so customers can access it directly from your store or landing page.

faq.question: Do I need coding skills to set up Stripe Checkout?
faq.answer: Basic checkout links can be created without coding, though embedding a custom checkout session on your own site usually requires some development work.

faq.question: Can I customize the look of the checkout page?
faq.answer: Yes, Stripe Checkout allows some branding customization, such as your logo and color scheme, within your dashboard settings.

faq.question: Does Stripe Checkout support multiple products?
faq.answer: Yes, you can add multiple products and let customers select quantities or options within a single checkout session.

faq.question: Is Stripe Checkout secure for customers?
faq.answer: Yes, Stripe Checkout is a hosted, PCI-compliant page, so sensitive card details never pass through your own server.
